implementation_ontology.actual_algorithm: Pinned cuBLAS single-precision pointer-array batched LU with partial pivoting, original native getrfBatched wrapper unchanged.
implementation_ontology.work_item_mapping: Actual CUDA.jl, KA and JACC device allocations passed via documented cuBLAS C ABI; no authored device kernels.

backend_extensions: Explicit pinned cuBLAS C ABI; CUDA-specific library dependency

reference_repair.finding: Historical CUDA.jl genuinely uses cuBLAS LU, but calls strided-batched wrapper with allocation of pivot/info outputs within ROI, whereas native uses pointer-array batched API with preallocated outputs. The study aligns raw pointer-array API, preallocation, pinned library and context-wide completion for all models. RNG inputs differ historically; all four consume an identical fully initialized named fixture. No historical wrong LU computation is established.
